spots.name: Bluff
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Bluff, New Zealand (town article)
spots.reason: About 25 km south of the Invercargill centre, inside its 75% span (33.75 km) and reached from the city; Stirling Point is already its spot. Gateway to Stewart Island.
spots.bio: The southernmost mainland port, known for Bluff oysters and the ferry to Stewart Island.

spots.name: Oreti Beach
spots.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint 'Oreti Beach' (Sandy Point access); Wikipedia centroid is -46.4019,168.132
spots.reason: About 16 km from the centre, inside the span, 15 minutes from the city. Long beach: pinned at its main access point, not the centroid.
spots.bio: Southland's long, flat surf beach, open to driving, with views of Stewart Island on clear days.

spots.name: Classic Motorcycle Mecca
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node tourism=museum 'Classic Motorcycles Mecca'
spots.reason: 2 km from the centre, inside the span. Two-floor ticketed museum (Wikivoyage Invercargill).
spots.bio: A two-floor museum of old and new motorcycles, part of Invercargill's Burt Munro heritage.

spots.name: Riverton
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Riverton / Aparima (town article)
spots.reason: About 27 km west of the Invercargill centre, inside the 33.75 km span and reached from Invercargill along the Southern Scenic Route.
spots.bio: A seaside town on the Aparima estuary with cafes, galleries and a rocky coast on the Southern Scenic Route.

spots.name: Bluff Hill Lookout
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node tourism=viewpoint 'Bluff Hill Lookout' (-46.61495,168.33878)
spots.reason: About 24 km from the centre, inside the span, above Bluff. Not Napier's Bluff Hill Lookout.
spots.bio: Motupohue's summit lookout, with views over Foveaux Strait to Stewart Island.
spots.note: Name collides with Napier's Bluff Hill Lookout: confirm the wiki title and photo are Southland's.

spots.name: Foveaux Walkway
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 1152771832 'Foveaux Walkway' at the Stirling Point end (-46.61325,168.3568); candidate point -46.5979,168.3195 was mid-track
spots.reason: About 24 km from the centre, inside the span; starts at Stirling Point, which is already a spot.
spots.bio: A 2.5-hour coastal walk from Stirling Point along Bluff's western shore.
spots.note: Confirm the DOC track page for the ticketUrl.

spots.name: Lake Te Anau
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 981891076 'Lake Te Anau' at the Te Anau lakefront (not the Wikipedia centroid, which is in the water)
spots.reason: Reached from Te Anau, 0 km from the park's lake base, inside the 105 km span.
spots.bio: The South Island's largest lake, with lakefront walks and cruises towards the western fiords.
spots.note: Distinct from the Te Anau town spot (fiordland-9).

spots.name: Lake Manapouri
spots.coordinates_source: OSM relation 2786702 centroid (in water); pin should move to a shore point
spots.reason: About 55 km from the park centre, inside the span; the start of the Doubtful Sound crossing.
spots.bio: A deep, island-dotted lake ringed by mountains, crossed by boat on the way to Doubtful Sound.
spots.note: Pin must be the lake shore, not Manapouri town (fiordland-13).

spots.name: Dusky Track
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node 'Hauroko Burn Hut' (DOC hut, near the Lake Hauroko end); a true trailhead point is still needed
spots.reason: About 97 km from the park centre, inside the 105 km span; a Fiordland National Park track.
spots.bio: A remote 8 to 10 day tramp from Lake Hauroko to Dusky Sound, for experienced, well-equipped walkers.

photo.file: Dusky Track Between Lake Roe and Loch Maree.JPG

spots.note: Huts need DOC passes; check cost.

spots.name: Te Anau Bird Sanctuary
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 1330766851 'Te Anau Bird Sanctuary / Punanga Manu o Te Anau' (DOC)
spots.reason: About 2 km from Te Anau, inside the span.
spots.bio: A DOC-run sanctuary of takahē and other native birds by the lake, a short walk from town.

spots.name: North West Circuit
spots.coordinates_source: OSM Freshwater Landing point given in skeptic.json (-46.8682482,167.9198088); DOC starts the walk at Lee Bay (shared with Rakiura Track), so this is a distinct point on the circuit
spots.reason: About 16 km from the island centre, inside the 34 km span; a 125 km circuit, its own spot and not the Rakiura Track.
spots.bio: A 125 km, nine to eleven day circuit of Stewart Island's northern coast, for experienced trampers.

photo.file: North West Circuit Track through grass northeast of Big Sandhill (near Mason Bay).jpg

spots.note: Huts and passes cost money: research cost.

spots.name: Southern Circuit
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 228365516 Rakiura National Park Visitor Centre, Oban (from skeptic.json)
spots.reason: The walk starts in Oban, inside the destination.
spots.bio: A 71.5 km, four to six day tramp round Stewart Island's southern coast, from Oban or by boat to Freshwater.
spots.note: Huts and passes cost money: research cost.

spots.name: Waipapa Point Lighthouse
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node man_made=lighthouse (-46.6600622,168.8470512)
spots.reason: About 49 km from the Catlins centre, inside its 52.5 km (75% of 70) span; the western gateway to the Catlins on the Southern Scenic Route.
spots.bio: An 1884 lighthouse built after the SS Tararua wreck, with sea lions on the nearby beach.

spots.name: Florence Hill Lookouts
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node tourism=viewpoint 'Florence Hill Lookout'
spots.reason: About 7 km from the Catlins centre, on the main road.
spots.bio: Two roadside lookouts over Tautuku Bay and its peninsula.

photo.file: View from Florence Hill lookout over Tautuku Bay.jpg

spots.name: Surat Bay
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node natural=bay 'Surat Bay' (bay centroid; check the beach access)
spots.reason: About 25 km from the Catlins centre, inside the span.
spots.bio: A beach with a colony of New Zealand sea lions among the dunes, 20 to 30 minutes' walk return.

spots.name: Mavora Lakes
spots.coordinates_source: OSM survey point 'Mavora Lakes' (-45.36653,168.11838); Wikipedia centroid -45.2556,168.168
spots.reason: About 60 km from the Fiordland centre but outside the national park (Mavora Lakes Conservation Park, Te Wahipounamu), reached via Mossburn, not from a park base.
spots.bio: Twin lakes ringed by tussock and beech in a conservation park, with camping and walking tracks.

photo.file: North Mavora Lake towards southwest with snow-covered Livingstone Mountains in the background.jpg

spots.name: Around the Mountains Cycle Trail
spots.coordinates_source: wikipedia:Around the Mountains Cycle Trail (centroid at Athol); a start point (Walter Peak / Athol) is needed
spots.reason: Runs from Walter Peak to Kingston and Mossburn; no destination holds it.
spots.bio: A multi-day cycle trail through the Southern Lakes high country, from Walter Peak to Kingston and Athol.

spots.name: South Coast Track
spots.coordinates_source: OSM way 503705694 'South Coast Track' at the Hump Ridge end (Rarakau); DOC to confirm trailhead (the candidate's -43.4,146.2 was the Tasmanian track)
spots.reason: About 130 km from the Fiordland centre, outside its span; links Hump Ridge with Lake Hauroko and has no base.
spots.bio: A DOC multi-day coastal tramp through Fiordland's south, linking Port Craig and Waitutu with Lake Hauroko.
spots.note: Not the Tasmanian South Coast Track.

spots.name: Colac Bay
spots.coordinates_source: OSM place node 'Colac Bay'
spots.reason: About 37 km from Invercargill, outside its 33.75 km span, on the Southern Scenic Route.
spots.bio: A surf beach and village on the Southern Scenic Route, one of Southland's best-known surf spots.

spots.name: Gemstone Beach
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node tourism=attraction 'Gemstone Beach'
spots.reason: 49 km from Invercargill, outside every span.
spots.bio: A shingle beach near Orepuki where visitors hunt for agate and other gemstones.

spots.name: Te Waewae Bay
spots.coordinates_source: OSM relation 9573839 centroid (bay); a headland lookout point is needed
spots.reason: About 70 km west of Invercargill, outside every span; viewed from the Southern Scenic Route headlands.
spots.bio: A wide bay along the Southern Scenic Route, home to one of the largest groups of Hector's dolphins.

photo.file: Pláž Te Waewae Bay, Pahia Hill - panoramio.jpg

spots.name: Hokonui Heritage Centre
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node tourism=museum 'Hokonui Moonshine Museum' (-46.0972934,168.9458511)
spots.reason: Gore is about 60 km from Invercargill, outside its span. Spot of proposed Gore, standalone until approved.
spots.bio: The Hokonui Moonshine Museum and Gore Historical Museum, telling the story of Southland's illicit whisky.

spots.name: Eastern Southland Gallery
spots.coordinates_source: OSM node tourism=gallery (-46.0979982,168.9460165)
spots.reason: Gore, outside every span. Spot of proposed Gore.
spots.bio: A free gallery in a former Carnegie library, with the Ralph Hotere and John Money collections.

spots.name: Brown Trout Statue
spots.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Gore listing; confirm on OSM
spots.reason: Gore, outside every span. Spot of proposed Gore. Roadside icon in the Ohakune Carrot class.
spots.bio: A 9 m brown trout sculpture at the entrance to Gore, the self-styled brown trout fishing capital.

new_destinations.name: Gore
new_destinations.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Southland region page (town point; confirm on Wikipedia Gore, New Zealand)
new_destinations.photo: none: only an ordinary main street on Commons (held)
new_destinations.case: Southland's second town (Wikivoyage chapter, 3 counted sources) with a museum, a gallery and the brown trout icon; about 60 km from Invercargill.
new_destinations.status: proposal only, needs description, reasons with photos, tips, best months, header

new_destinations.name: Tuatapere
new_destinations.coordinates_source: base for the Southern Scenic Route's west leg; confirm on OSM place node (not taken from a source here)
new_destinations.photo: none (town was review, photo not sought)
new_destinations.case: Five kept places round one base, but Tuatapere itself is a REVIEW verdict (a services stop whose draw is the journey beyond), so the proposal depends on the owner approving it. If declined, all five stay as they are (two existing standalone, three new standalone).
new_destinations.status: proposal only, needs the owner's decision on Tuatapere, then description, reasons with photos, tips, best months, header

new_destination_note: Two new destinations proposed for the owner: Gore (town with museum, gallery and the Brown Trout icon, standalone spots until approved) and Tuatapere (depends on the Tuatapere review verdict; clusters Hump Ridge, Clifden Bridge, Te Waewae Bay, Gemstone Beach, Colac Bay). Bluff is kept as a spot of Invercargill, not a destination: it is 25 km from the centre, inside its span, and a Bluff destination would overlap Invercargill. Riverton is inside Invercargill's span and a spot of it. Catlins spots Nugget Point, Curio Bay, Cathedral Caves, McLean Falls, Purakaunui Falls and Slope Point already exist (catlins-1 to 6) and are not duplicated; Waipapa Point Lighthouse, Florence Hill Lookouts and Surat Bay are new. Ids continue from the git-history maximum: invercargill-4, fiordland-18, stewart-island-5, catlins-6.
